title: harnessed agent
description: An AI coding harness definition (catalog/agents/<name>/agent.yaml). Declares how the harness container image is built. An agent is NOT a recipe — recipes compose ONTO an agent. See ARCHITECTURE.md §Vocabulary and docs/harnessed-design.md §6/§8.

type.description: Catalog kind marker. Always 'agent' for an agent manifest.

harness.description: The AI coding harness this agent runs. Exactly one per agent. All harnesses consume the same Claude-canonical profile; they differ only in how they read it and reach hatago (design §8).

image.description: The container image tag built for this agent (e.g. harnessed-claude). FROM harnessed-base + the harness CLI installer.

dockerfile.description: Path (repo-relative) to the Dockerfile that builds this agent image.

build_args.description: Build arguments passed to `podman build` for this agent's image (each as --build-arg NAME=value). The single source of truth for pinned tool versions (e.g. OMP_VERSION); the agent Dockerfile's matching ARG carries no default. Keys must match the Dockerfile ARG names. A value may be a bare scalar, or a mapping carrying the resolver hint and hold reason alongside it.

value.description: The pinned version. This — and only this — becomes --build-arg NAME=<value>.

spec.description: A mise spec naming where the version comes from (e.g. github:can1357/oh-my-pi), so `harnessed update` can ask for a newer one. A resolver hint, never a second installer: the Dockerfile still performs the install. Omit it when no upstream can be queried — the pin is then reported UNRESOLVED rather than guessed at.

hold.description: Freeze this pin: it is listed for information and never offered for bump. Must state WHY. A hold does not license an unpinned value.

unpinnable.description: Declared NON-pins: acquisitions with no version selector that preserves integrity, so the agent takes whatever its installer gives and moves only on a deliberate rebuild. Keys use the same namespace as build_args (the ARG name the pin would have carried) and must NOT also appear there. Each reason must name the integrity mechanism that blocks pinning — this is the audited exception to 'pin every download', not a way around it.
